plan.analysis: Inclusion is the bottleneck (recall 0.359, 130/179 missed) and its misses are overwhelmingly tiny faint vertical streaks (median missed 33.6px vs train 90.5px; low-size-tertile recall only 0.185 on n=146). Patches (0.72) and scratches (0.68) are stable but their low-size-tertile recall (~0.5) still lags, and both dipped slightly in R2 when starved, so they need a steady feed. R2's inclusion gain (+0.018) came from any_class backgrounds + prefer_small at a 0.45 min scale; the 0.35 min of R1 added unlearnable noise, so I keep min >=0.4 but bias small to hit the missed size regime.
plan.rationale: Spend the majority on inclusion (the only sub-0.4 class) but cap it near the ~80-cumulative diminishing-returns line (55+30=85) and keep patches/scratches at a non-starving 10 each so the shared detector doesn't regress. Inclusion: thin faint small sources (11,150,268,277,297,50,99,100,106) at 0.4-0.9 prefer_small on any_class backgrounds to match the small low-contrast missed streaks while avoiding R1's unlearnable 0.35 pastes. Patches/scratches: all sources with prefer_small to cover the small dark-blob and thin-line misses at learnable scales on same-class steel backgrounds.

plan.analysis: Preview confirms the plan: inclusion pastes are thin faint small streaks matching the missed low-contrast vertical/horizontal streaks; patches are dark blobs of varied size matching the missed dark spots; scratches are thin bright lines in multiple orientations matching the missed thin lines. No unrealistic, oversized, or useless pastes; sizes stay in the learnable small-to-medium band. Keeping the same allocation and params.
